The supplied claim does not address customer concentration. Source evidence reading:522a93374394b9ec3061 states top-five customer sales of 49,827.02万元, 22.45% of annual sales, including related-party sales of 24,984.53万元, 11.26%; this major output-exposure condition is omitted from the claims.

The supplied claim does not address supplier concentration. Source evidence reading:f8570d604a5f27b8e1c0 states top-five supplier purchases of 40,406.77万元, 31.90% of annual purchases, including related-party purchases of 5,239.65万元, 4.14%; this major input-exposure condition is omitted from the claims.

The supplied claim does not address operating cost composition. Source evidence reading:586c032107b1180b0377 lists 业务运行成本, 人工成本, 折旧, 网络运行成本, and 智能卡及机顶盒等摊销成本 as cost components; no supplied claim covers this major input-exposure condition.

The supplied claim only mentions 千兆宽带, 5G用户服务, and set-top-box products; it does not mention the “歌华云” platform, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS capabilities, or the large/small-screen and wired/wireless converged video service scenario stated in source evidence reading:205f63e87240eb49458e. This major product/service condition is omitted from the claims.

The supplied claim states that the company develops series set-top-box products for multiple home video scenarios and advances 4K ultra-high-definition, IP, and gateway set-top-box hardware/software R&D and marketing. This covers the condition’s core set-top-box product-set assertion, supported by reading:8395330e3b4105f6abb2 and reading:f1ccdb1ea8db80a9507f.

The claim is supported by the supplied evidence: reading:0bec4d97922b04a51d1c supports 千兆宽带业务, reading:477d72e26c1b23cca0d6 supports 5G用户规模持续提升, and reading:c8ff6f15f1ce8ceb89e5 and reading:f1ccdb1ea8db80a9507f support the series set-top-box products and 4K/IP/gateway R&D and marketing. No unsupported numeric fact is added.

No supplied claim covers the Beijing cable TV network operating rights or the 16-district information network. The only claim addresses revenue_model revenue/cost and cost components; it does not assert network operating rights or coverage.

Claim_revenue_model_1 covers this condition by stating the company earns revenue and incurs operating cost through the cable TV industry, consistent with the 主营业务分行业 cable TV industry table on page 18.

The claim is supported by pages 18-19: 2025 revenue is 221,975.46万元 and operating cost is 208,523.67万元, and the cost components include 折旧、智能卡及机顶盒等摊销成本、业务运行成本、人工成本、网络运行成本等. No numeric, period, or unit error is evident.

提供的观点中未包含对5G核心网二期建设、固话技术平台及5G业务发展的相关内容，该重要条件未被覆盖。
